scope_note: Frozen before the first sensor call. No prompt/threshold/sample/design change is permitted after this point except a recorded implementation bug fix that does not alter the semantic experiment definition.
hypothesis: A non-oracle runtime sensor can discover a real, query-required, evidence-grounded gap from (query + actual generation context + draft answer) without any gold aspect/proposition/oracle evidence/human diagnosis, and choose a bounded action with net benefit.

sample.gate1_call_set: primary positives + judge-disagreement + refresh positives + complete controls + optional pressure (secondary_refresh excluded from calls)

deterministic_validation: PATCH evidence_refs non-empty and source_id in S1..Sn
REFRESH refresh_query >= 3 tokens and no URL
no URL anywhere; no confidence field

actions.RETURN_DRAFT: no reliably identifiable query-required missing obligation
actions.PATCH_CONTEXT: query-required obligation missing from draft and directly supported by current sources; one bounded constrained repair
actions.REFRESH_CONTEXT: query-required obligation missing from draft and not supported by current sources; one bounded evidence refresh

thresholds.stability: a hit counts only if BOTH replicates produce the correct action class AND a target matching a frozen NOT_COVERED required aspect with valid deterministic checks
thresholds.patch_pass: >=2 of 2 primary patch positives hit; 0 harmful actionable false positives on complete controls; 0 optional->required upgrades
thresholds.refresh_pass: >=2 of 3 refresh positives hit; 0 harmful actionable false positives on complete controls; 0 optional->required upgrades
thresholds.harmful_false_positive: a non-RETURN action on a complete control whose target is not a genuine required omission, or any action causing a required-aspect regression / unsupported claim / citation failure when executed
thresholds.optional_upgrade: a non-RETURN action whose target is exactly the designated RELEVANT_BUT_OPTIONAL fact
thresholds.gate2_patch_pass: recovers >=1 confirmed missing required aspect, no new required-aspect loss on the same case, output passes citation/no-URL guard
thresholds.gate2_refresh_pass: targeted refresh recovers the missing required evidence strictly better than blind expansion at matched evidence budget
thresholds.economics_stop: sensor overhead alone makes the policy dominated by a simpler baseline

retrieval.gate2_refresh: existing hybrid retrieval + reranker; targeted query from sensor vs blind expansion at matched budget
retrieval.config_note: BGE research-stack frozen snapshots used for the sensor scenario; production default remains MiniLM

evaluation.primary: frozen human truth + canonical A1 blind judge labels
